overview.description: The State Street SPDR S&P Retail ETF (XRT) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Retail Select Industry index. The fund tracks a broad-based, equal-weighted index of stocks in the US retail industry. XRT was launched on Jun 19, 2006 and is issued by State Street.
